capabilities: Convert Markdown documents to complete LaTeX source with package declarations
Auto-select and style table LaTeX environments (tabular, tabularx, longtable, booktabs)
Compile PDFs in-browser using the SwiftLaTeX WebAssembly XeTeX engine
Export .tex files or copy LaTeX output to the clipboard
Configure document class, font size, page size, wrapping thresholds and Chinese support
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX math renderer for note preview; it converts whole Markdown documents into LaTeX source and compiled PDFs.
extras: README is in Chinese and describes a standalone React web app (with GitHub Pages/Vercel/Netlify deployment guides) more than an Obsidian plugin; the manifest mentions local latexmk PDF compilation, which differs from the README's pure-frontend SwiftLaTeX approach. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Markdown notes into LaTeX source documents or compiled PDFs, especially with professional table formatting.
summary: Markdown-to-LaTeX converter with smart table handling that generates .tex files and compiles PDFs in-browser via the SwiftLaTeX WebAssembly engine.
